purpose: DOC-specific literature motivated baseline comparison on existing development tasks

papers.name: Aqua-OC
papers.methods_verified: RF, XGBoost, SVR and DNN; optical-water-type-specific model selection
papers.comparison: XGBoost and RBF-SVR algorithm-level baselines with our permitted covariates
papers.not_reproduced: Landsat reflectance, water-quality spectral indices, seven ERA5-Land variables, optical water type clustering and type-specific model selection, original random 70/20/10 split and 10-fold tuning
required_missing_inputs: ERA5-Land LAI, air temperature, wind, solar radiation, water evaporation and precipitation
papers.code_status: Main text and author-hosted supplement inspected; no runnable implementation link established

papers.name: Yangtze monthly DOC reconstruction
papers.methods_verified: Random Forest selected from five machine learning models; monthly Xuliujing reconstruction for 2001-2020
papers.comparison: Ecological RF with our available environmental and current hydroclimatic covariates; algorithm-level comparison
papers.not_reproduced: Original Yangtze covariate set, KPCA analyses, original site calibration and original tuning
required_missing_inputs: monthly NDVI, soil moisture, PET, GPP and precipitation
annual population density, shrubland and grassland

papers.name: Temperate river network DOC GAM
papers.methods_verified: DOC concentration GAM with catchment area, discharge condition and interaction; global environmental GAM and RF
papers.comparison: Pooled pyGAM ecological smooths and area-by-local-discharge tensor interaction
papers.not_reproduced: R mgcv cubic regression splines with k=3, river-mouth flow conditions, station-median global response and terrestrial primary productivity

papers.name: INCA-C

adaptation_status: All new numerical arms are literature motivated algorithm or model-family comparisons, not complete paper reproductions.
target: Native DOC concentration in mg C/L; flux, TOC, fDOM and BDOC papers are not treated as interchangeable DOC concentration models.
